Trend gate is passed (eligible=true), durability is healthy at 0.69, and breadth is excellent at 0.955 — a cohesive, near-universal up-move. theses.thesis: Although this theme has the highest momentum score (2.305, rank 1), it FAILS the absolute-trend gate (eligible=false) with breadth 0.0 and a very low durability_bar of 0.30.
